reading.body:
CyrusOne Lewisville DFW2 publishes 12 MW of IT capacity, ranking 12th among 19 Texas facilities with disclosed figures and holding just 2.5 percent of the state's 475 MW of announced IT load.

At typical AI training density of 40 kW per rack, 12 MW supports roughly 300 racks, a scale better suited to regulated enterprise workloads than to frontier training clusters. The facility's PCI DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, FISMA, SSAE 16 Type II, and TIA-942 certifications reinforce that role in finance, healthcare, and government.

Texas has 133 mapped data center sites, but most publish no capacity, so the 475 MW figure covers only the 19 facilities that disclose numbers. This site is a minor contributor to that published supply, and with no announced expansion and no disclosed grid headroom in the Dallas-Fort Worth region, its future relevance to AI scaling cannot be assessed from available data.
